content: This resource tells to explore the relationship between driven current and driving emf in three simple circuits that contain: (1) only resistance; (2) only inductance; and (3) only capacitance, to examine these same relationships in the general case where R, L, and C are all present, and to do two sample problems on the LRC circuits.
